title: City Attorney report and draft Ordinance relative to the renewal of a franchise granted to PS Southern California One, LLC, successor to PS Storage REIT, to…
text:
[Council File 25-0782]
City Attorney report and draft Ordinance relative to the renewal of a franchise granted to PS Southern California One, LLC, successor to PS Storage REIT, to install and maintain an Information Technology Systems facility in the public right-of-way at 1617 Pontius Avenue and 1606 Cotner Avenue.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
No
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Renews a city franchise letting PS Storage's successor operate an information technology systems facility in the public right-of-way at 1617 Pontius Avenue and 1606 Cotner Avenue.
